title: coluteastrum sulcatum
intro: Coluteastrum sulcatum, commonly known as the hairy wistaria vine, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Coluteastrum sulcatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-diabetic and anti-hyperlipidemic effects. Additionally, the plant has been found to exhibit neuroprotective and cardioprotective properties, making it a subject of interest for further research into its medicinal applications.
